top_signals.title: Euro Bearish Bias Persists in Options and Charts Before ECB
top_signals.summary: The euro is trading near its weakest level since May 2025 in the run-up to the European Central Bank’s interest rate meeting later Thursday, with options and technical signals pointing to the risk of further losses.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
